title: Page Sections

sub_fields.label: Background Color
sub_fields.name: background_color
sub_fields.instructions: Navy = page hero. Accent blue = mid-page CTA.

sub_fields.label: Background Image
sub_fields.name: background_image
sub_fields.instructions: Full-bleed photo behind the content card.

sub_fields.label: Show Logo
sub_fields.name: show_logo
sub_fields.instructions: Homepage: on. Pillar pages: off (use subtitle instead).

sub_fields.label: Logo
sub_fields.name: logo
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. When Show Logo is on and this is empty, the theme logo is used (Navy only).

sub_fields.label: Subtitle Parent
sub_fields.name: subtitle_parent
sub_fields.instructions: Optional eyebrow parent, e.g. What We Do (muted, before the slash).

sub_fields.label: Subtitle
sub_fields.name: subtitle
sub_fields.instructions: Optional eyebrow above the title, e.g. Family & Early Childhood Development.

sub_fields.label: Body
sub_fields.name: body
sub_fields.instructions: Optional supporting paragraph under the heading.

sub_fields.label: Primary CTA Style
sub_fields.name: primary_cta_style
sub_fields.instructions: Homepage uses Accent (red). Pillar pages use Accent Blue.

sub_fields.label: Stats
sub_fields.name: stats
sub_fields.instructions: Desktop order is left-to-right. Mobile reorders people → countries → funds when presets are used.

sub_fields.label: Icon
sub_fields.name: icon
sub_fields.instructions: Optional custom icon. If empty, the preset icon is used.

sub_fields.label: Icon Preset
sub_fields.name: icon_preset
sub_fields.instructions: Used when Icon is empty, and for mobile sort order.

sub_fields.label: Value
sub_fields.name: value
sub_fields.instructions: Numeric value that counts up on scroll (e.g. 999999).

sub_fields.label: Heading
sub_fields.name: heading
sub_fields.instructions: e.g. The challenge we are solving

sub_fields.label: Cards
sub_fields.name: cards
sub_fields.instructions: Three fact cards + one CTA card (style = CTA).

sub_fields.label: Icon
sub_fields.name: icon
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. If empty, the preset icon is used.

sub_fields.label: CTA Link
sub_fields.name: link
sub_fields.instructions: Only used when Style is CTA.

sub_fields.label: Heading
sub_fields.name: heading
sub_fields.instructions: e.g. How Impact On Million works

sub_fields.label: Steps
sub_fields.name: steps
sub_fields.instructions: White process bars under the heading.

sub_fields.label: Programme Pillars
sub_fields.name: pillars
sub_fields.instructions: Desktop wraps as a grid. Mobile is a horizontal carousel.

sub_fields.label: Icon
sub_fields.name: icon
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. If empty, the preset icon is used.

sub_fields.label: Countries
sub_fields.name: countries
sub_fields.instructions: Slug must match map IDs: china, vietnam, indonesia, india, bangladesh, sri-lanka.

sub_fields.label: Heading
sub_fields.name: heading
sub_fields.instructions: e.g. A message from Ida Hyllested,

sub_fields.label: Portrait / Thumbnail
sub_fields.name: image
sub_fields.instructions: Video poster image. Returns attachment ID.

sub_fields.label: Video URL
sub_fields.name: video_url
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. Play button links here (YouTube, Vimeo, etc.).

sub_fields.label: Logos
sub_fields.name: logos
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. Leave empty to use the default partner logo set. Upload an image or pick a preset.

sub_fields.label: Heading (Desktop)
sub_fields.name: heading
sub_fields.instructions: e.g. Our Impact - Timeline to One Million

sub_fields.label: Image
sub_fields.name: image
sub_fields.instructions: Portrait or field photo. Desktop: left side. Mobile: top.

sub_fields.label: Icon
sub_fields.name: icon
sub_fields.instructions: Optional custom icon. If empty, the preset is used.

sub_fields.label: CTA
sub_fields.name: cta
sub_fields.instructions: Blue filled button (e.g. How can I make an impact?).

sub_fields.label: Primary CTA
sub_fields.name: primary_cta
sub_fields.instructions: Accent blue filled button (e.g. Get involved).

sub_fields.label: Icon
sub_fields.name: icon
sub_fields.instructions: Optional custom icon. If empty, the preset is used.

sub_fields.label: Audiences
sub_fields.name: audiences
sub_fields.instructions: Metric values are at the Baseline Amount (default $100,000) and scale with the slider.

sub_fields.label: Baseline Amount
sub_fields.name: baseline_amount
sub_fields.instructions: Amount the audience metric values are defined at (default 100000).

description: Flexible content sections for Impact One Million pages.
